description: LibreWPF transport package with portable managed presentation assemblies, references, themes, XAML build tasks, and runtime metadata.
releaseNotes: Consumes ProGPU preview.43 retained canvas-state routing and typed bitmap-flush clip rebasing; bounds bitmap, shader-sampler, viewport, custom-font, and visual-replay retention with typed CPU/GPU ownership diagnostics; releases retained scene ownership on disposal; suppresses idle static-frame rendering; preserves nonactivating window state and settled popup placement; and retains alpha-capable X11 transparent windows and native Cocoa popups.
